_comment: Written by the :run skill after the fetch step. It records which metadata surface each raw file came from, which tool fetched it, and — critically — whether the call SUCCEEDED. analyze.py uses ok:false to tell 'blind' apart from 'clean'.

sources.name: salesforce_org
sources.query: SELECT Id, Name, IsSandbox, InstanceName, OrganizationType, FiscalYearStartMonth FROM Organization

sources.name: salesforce_users
sources.query: SELECT Id, Name, Username, Email, IsActive, UserType, ProfileId, Profile.Name, Profile.UserLicense.Name, ManagerId, Manager.Name, Manager.IsActive, CreatedById, CreatedBy.Name, CreatedBy.IsActive, LastLoginDate, CreatedDate FROM User

sources.name: salesforce_login_history
sources.query: SELECT UserId, LoginTime, Application, Status, SourceIp FROM LoginHistory WHERE LoginTime = LAST_N_DAYS:90

sources.name: salesforce_oauth_tokens
sources.query: SELECT Id, AppName, UserId, User.Name, LastUsedDate, UseCount FROM OauthToken

sources.name: salesforce_permset_assignments
sources.query: SELECT AssigneeId, PermissionSetId, PermissionSet.Name, PermissionSet.PermissionsModifyAllData, PermissionSet.PermissionsViewAllData, PermissionSet.PermissionsApiEnabled, PermissionSet.IsOwnedByProfile FROM PermissionSetAssignment

sources.name: salesforce_object_permissions
sources.query: SELECT ParentId, SobjectType, PermissionsCreate, PermissionsEdit, PermissionsDelete, PermissionsModifyAllRecords FROM ObjectPermissions WHERE PermissionsEdit = true

sources.name: salesforce_connected_apps
sources.query: SELECT Id, Name, CreatedDate, CreatedBy.Name, LastModifiedDate, LastModifiedBy.Name, OptionsAllowAdminApprovedUsersOnly FROM ConnectedApplication

sources.name: salesforce_installed_packages
sources.query: SELECT Id, SubscriberPackage.Name, SubscriberPackage.NamespacePrefix, SubscriberPackage.PublisherName, SubscriberPackageVersion.Name, SubscriberPackageVersion.MajorVersion, SubscriberPackageVersion.MinorVersion FROM InstalledSubscriberPackage

sources.name: salesforce_flows
sources.query: SELECT DurableId, ApiName, Label, ProcessType, TriggerType, TriggerObjectOrEvent.QualifiedApiName, IsActive, VersionNumber, LastModifiedDate, LastModifiedBy.Name, NamespacePrefix, IsOutOfDate, Description FROM FlowDefinitionView

sources.name: salesforce_flow_versions
sources.query: SELECT DurableId, FlowDefinitionViewId, ApiName, Label, VersionNumber, Status, ProcessType FROM FlowVersionView

sources.name: salesforce_flow_metadata
sources.query: SELECT Id, FullName, Metadata FROM Flow WHERE Id = '301...'   -- repeated per active flow

sources.name: salesforce_apex_triggers
sources.query: SELECT Id, Name, TableEnumOrId, Status, ApiVersion, UsageBeforeInsert, UsageBeforeUpdate, UsageAfterInsert, UsageAfterUpdate, UsageBeforeDelete, LengthWithoutComments, LastModifiedDate, LastModifiedBy.Name, Body FROM ApexTrigger

sources.name: salesforce_apex_classes
sources.query: SELECT Id, Name, NamespacePrefix, Status, ApiVersion, LengthWithoutComments, LastModifiedDate, LastModifiedBy.Name FROM ApexClass

sources.name: salesforce_validation_rules
sources.query: SELECT Id, ValidationName, EntityDefinition.QualifiedApiName, Active, ErrorMessage, ErrorDisplayField, LastModifiedDate, LastModifiedBy.Name FROM ValidationRule

sources.name: salesforce_workflow_rules
sources.query: SELECT Id, Name, TableEnumOrId, LastModifiedDate, LastModifiedBy.Name, Metadata FROM WorkflowRule

sources.name: salesforce_workflow_field_updates
sources.query: SELECT Id, Name, TableEnumOrId, LastModifiedDate, Metadata FROM WorkflowFieldUpdate

sources.name: salesforce_assignment_rules
sources.query: SELECT Id, Name, SobjectType, Active, LastModifiedDate, LastModifiedBy.Name FROM AssignmentRule

sources.name: salesforce_scheduled_jobs
sources.query: SELECT Id, CronJobDetail.Name, CronJobDetail.JobType, CronExpression, State, NextFireTime, PreviousFireTime, StartTime, TimesTriggered, CreatedDate, CreatedBy.Name, CreatedBy.IsActive FROM CronTrigger

sources.name: salesforce_entities
sources.query: SELECT DurableId, QualifiedApiName, Label, KeyPrefix, IsCustomSetting, NamespacePrefix FROM EntityDefinition WHERE IsQueryable = true

sources.name: salesforce_record_counts
sources.query: GET /services/data/v62.0/limits/recordCount?sObjects=Account,Contact,Lead,Opportunity,Case,Task,Event,Integration_Log__c,...

sources.name: salesforce_field_definitions
sources.query: SELECT QualifiedApiName, EntityDefinition.QualifiedApiName, NamespacePrefix, DataType FROM FieldDefinition WHERE EntityDefinition.QualifiedApiName = 'Opportunity'   -- repeated per object

sources.name: salesforce_setup_audit_trail
sources.query: SELECT Id, Action, Section, CreatedDate, CreatedBy.Name, Display FROM SetupAuditTrail WHERE CreatedDate = LAST_N_DAYS:30 ORDER BY CreatedDate DESC

sources.name: salesforce_api_events
sources.error: INVALID_TYPE: sObject type 'ApiEvent' is not supported
sources.query: SELECT Client, ApiType, COUNT(Id) FROM ApiEvent WHERE EventDate = LAST_N_DAYS:30 GROUP BY Client, ApiType

sources.name: salesforce_flow_executions
sources.error: EventLogFile returned 0 rows for EventType = 'FlowExecution' — Event Monitoring is not licensed on this org
sources.query: SELECT Id, EventType, LogDate, LogFileLength FROM EventLogFile WHERE EventType = 'FlowExecution'
